name: Sac County, IA
findings: Sac County has 37 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (16%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (67% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Sac County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Sac County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Sac County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
